title: Derived global germ compatibility with exchange
statement: For any cartesian square (f,f′,g,g′) [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], any separably closed geometric point t of Y′ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], and K∈D⁺(X_et,Ab) [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the canonical derived pulled global germ followed by D(stalk_t) of exchange [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] equals RΓ of the derived adjunction unit followed by Leray and then the target canonical derived global germ [def-weil-pbc-derived-global-germ]. No invertibility of either germ, strict-local hypothesis, properness or torsion is assumed.

proof.text: Form the source and target natural transformations δ and ε with their associators and apply Functor.rightDerived_ext to RΓ_X and its unit. On each bounded below homotopy complex, the source unit factorization computes δ as Qh of the underived source composite a followed by c; the target factorization computes ε as Qh of b followed by the identical c. Rewrite a=b using underived germ compatibility. Thus the two transformations agree after precomposition with the unit and hence agree. Evaluate on K and simplify identity associators and unitors.
